_comment: Copy to ~/.claude/ha-devices.json and fill in your own rooms. This file maps a spoken room name to the HA entity SLUG of the Echo in it — 'kitchen' -> media_player.echo_kitchen. Values are entity slugs, never notify-service names: Alexa Media Player derives notify.alexa_media_<name> from the device name in your Alexa account, so renaming an Echo in the Alexa app silently deletes its notify service, while entity IDs survive renames. Override the path with BRAVROS_HA_DEVICES. Read by BOTH the binary (cli/internal/ha/devices.go) and scripts/announce.sh, so there is exactly one map per machine.
_comment_hass_token_op_ref: OPTIONAL. 1Password secret reference scripts/announce.sh reads the Home Assistant long-lived token from when HASS_TOKEN is not already exported — 'op://<Vault>/<Item>/<field>'. Env BRAVROS_HASS_TOKEN_OP_REF overrides it; with neither set, `op` is never invoked. Put the reference here, never the token itself.
